subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: evaluation sprint & target close timeline
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@carebridgehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: evaluation sprint & target close timeline

Claire / team —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) thread started so we can align owners, define success criteria, and lock a realistic evaluation cadence toward a target commercial close. High-level ask below — proposed details attached.

Quick summary / goals:
- Scope: 6-week evaluation of Redwood inference for CareBridge triage assistant (security/privacy option: private-hosted config)
- Success criteria: accuracy on 3 benchmark datasets (triage intent, redaction, escalation recall), latency <200ms p95 on standard batches, and integration sanity check with their staging API
- Target commercial close: 2026-12-08 (allows procurement + SOC review)

Proposed owners (please confirm / edit):
- CareBridge product & validation lead: Sarah Miller (you to confirm)
- Redwood model/config owner: Rishi Malhotra
- Redwood prompts & prompt ownership: Marissa Cole
- Redwood eval & bench owner: Laura Bennett

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx (draft plan), benchmark-template.csv (example metrics + data schema).

Requested next steps:
1) Claire, confirm internal stakeholders and whether procurement/legal need to be looped now (we can include them on the timeline).
2) Everyone: confirm owners or propose alternates by EOD Monday 10/25.
3) If accepted, let's schedule a 30-min kickoff this week to walk the MAP and agree on bench definitions — propose Thu 10/24 10:00am PT or Fri 10/25 9:00am PT.

I added a few baseline SLOs and a proposed rapid bench so we can iterate quickly. Happy to tighten anything — want to make this as operational as possible so your engineering team can validate quickly.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Hi Nikhil — thanks, this looks helpful and clear.

Quick notes:
- Confirming Sarah Miller (product) and I will be primary internal owners. I'll also loop procurement (procurement@carebridgehealth.com) once we lock timelines.
- The target close of 12/08 is ambitious but workable if we move quickly on security docs. Do you have a SOC2 summary and data handling matrix we can attach?
- For kickoff time, Thu 10/24 10:00am PT works for Sarah and me.

A couple of asks on the MAP doc: can you add a short row for OMS/infra requirements (VPC peering, egress rules) so our infra team can prelim check? Also please include expected token volumes per day for billing projections.

I'll confirm the larger stakeholder roster after the kickoff. See you Thursday.

Claire Thompson
Head of Product, CareBridge Health
[Sent from my mobile]

Thanks everyone — great to get confirmations. Attached is an updated one-pager MAP timeline (MAP-timeline.png) with the following outline:

Week 0 (kickoff 10/24): agree bench definitions, infra checklist, sign off list of datasets
Weeks 1-2: seed data + integration (staging), run first-pass bench (recall/precision, hallucination checks)
Weeks 3-4: iterate prompts and model variants, measure latency and cost profiles, run blind evals
Week 5: integration validation and QA run with CareBridge test harness
Week 6: final results, exec summary, and prepare procurement packet for commercial close (target 12/08)

Open items (we should resolve before EOD 10/26):
- Security artifacts: Claire, please advise which artifacts we need up front (SOC2 summary, data retention policy, KMS details).
- Infra checklist: I added VPC peering + minimal egress flow; Claire please confirm whether additional firewall rules are needed.
- Bench datasets: Laura — can you confirm how many labeled examples you need per test?

If we close those open items quickly we should be able to maintain the Dec 8 window. I also pasted a short doc link below with quick token burn examples.

DocuSign (procurement) link (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/link/CARE-12873
Drive (bench templates): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_bench_template_example

Thanks,
Nikhil
[Attachment: MAP-timeline.png (image/png)]

All — thanks for the update and the clear timeline. Procurement is now looped (procurement@carebridgehealth.com) and will expect the final exec summary + a short SOW + license terms before routing for purchase order.

Security artifacts we need up front: SOC2 type 2 summary, data handling matrix (how long logs are retained, masking policies), and a short KMS/HSM note. If you can provide those by 11/05 that gives us time to review with InfoSec.

Laura — for bench datasets, 500 labeled examples per test (intent, redaction, escalation) should be sufficient for a first-pass. If we see volatility we'll expand.

Confirming kickoff Thu 10/24 10:00am PT — Sarah and I will be on the call; if you need meeting notes I can share.

Claire Thompson
Head of Product, CareBridge Health
